notes:
Same use case with the variant "Agent: authored id first, then map" selected (`when` actor-type = agent; persona Dex). Full length 1440×1640.

**A variant is shown as its difference to the base, never as a full copy.**

**Variant panel** (under the chips): "Applies when" + the `when` condition as a dimension | value chip, "matches N personas" + their avatars, description, legend of `uc-diff-badge`s, what the variant overrides (here: personas).

**Coverage — a full-width section of the detail column** (as built; replaces the experiment's 320px side panel). Placed after People, before Trigger/Goal/Outcome. Table: first column = flows (Base, each variant; the selected row has the active fill), then one column per trait value grouped under its dimension (`colgroup` headers). Dot = the flow handles this value (Base: from its personas' traits; a variant: the values in its `when`); "any" = no condition on that dimension (one cell spanning the dimension). A value column no flow covers is a **gap**: amber column (header + cells) with "gap" under the label. Below: legend line, then a box "8 gaps: Role (…); Project size (…); Adoption (…). Ask your agent to draft variants for them:" + copyable prompt "Suggest variants for map-step-to-element" (`chrome-code-field block`). Same rule as the `suggest_use_case_variants` tool. Build: the table scrolls horizontally inside a `role="region"` wrapper with a sticky first column; the drawing wraps long headers to fit.

**Flow diff.**
- Changed (amber left border + `uc-diff-badge`): new text, then "Actor was ~~Dana~~ · Base: ~~old action~~".
- Added (green border, `added`) — not present in this sample.
- Removed (`removed`): dashed red ghost row with the struck base step and a reason; keeps its place in the sequence.
- From base (dimmed to 62%, grey border, `base`).
Numbering follows the effective flow. Inputs and outputs follow below as in `usecases-detail` (not redrawn; when a variant replaces them the column title gets a Changed badge, changed rows amber with the old value struck, new rows green).

Flows: Base chip → `usecases-detail`; + Variant → `usecases-edit-dialog-variant`.
